notes: All leaves are planned. Root alone may mark REF01 verified after actual implementation/test receipts; this draft makes no completion claims.
Existing #1–#16 stay B01–B16 rollup epics; B17 is new FieldPack epic. Sum unique leaf estimates only; old parent hours and 40/120/240h promises are superseded, not additive.

Owner roles are suggestions, not real assignees. Status readiness requires prerequisites/evidence/resources; Done requires scoped passing verification with commit/environment/results and actual review method.

R13/R20/R21/R22 remain external-evidence-only; no task fabricates qualification, partnerships, European tenure or international collaboration. R09 commercial shipping and R18 genuine cross-team work also need separate career evidence.

Canonical caps: 32 files,128MiB/file AND aggregate,64KiB chunks,16KiB manifest,4KiB metadata,16KiB IPC frame/response,16 sessions,4 outstanding/session,16 queued+1running,17 retained job descriptors,64 retained results/60s/1MiB encoded metadata.

Flat lowercase 1–64 ASCII aliases only; final portable reserved-name policy reconciled with reference implementation. Unknown fields/duplicate JSON keys rejected; no source URI/path/original filename exported.

Agent02 wins conflicts: 32 not16/100 files;128MiB not256MiB; first-terminal-commit cancellation; matching retained file metadata returns original job and closes duplicate descriptor, not a second file read.

Android supports read-only regular seekable whole-file descriptors; positional reads avoid shared cursor; blocked reads retain physical slot until exit. AOSP generated-sha256-v1 ONLY; real-file FD AOSP expansion rejected/deferred.

Native field UI implementations are independent after shared FD/SDK contract; desktop starts from core and host feasibility, not Flutter. Measurement execution depends on relevant Android baseline, not desktop release.

Verification procedures marked proposed are future contracts, not existing command claims. Evidence paths are planned repository-relative locations, not existing artifacts; root should reconcile REF01 actual paths.
P02 is an active-work feasibility spike; failed timebox means blocker and new estimate, not completed boot gate. M03 and P08 campaign active hours exclude separately described device runtime.

Integrity is observed-byte matching, not authenticity, malware scanning, immutable snapshot, cloud transfer, exactly-once execution or kernel work. All jobs volatile; new broker epoch invalidates handles.

REF01 is dependency-free because its delivered reference contract is independent of future native C02/FP01 adoption. Root reports 12 passing tests, normal/optimized demo and scoped independent AI review; root sets final status after linking actual receipts. Range 6–12h is historical estimate, not elapsed work.

G1 native proof uses generated-sha256-v1; FP01 is contract adoption only. Actual Android/Flutter/macOS FieldPack integration is G2. Runnable reference is separate reference stage and does not close G1/G2 native leaves.

tickets.title: Freeze FieldPack manifest, file profile and shared negative vectors
tickets.value: Give producer and recipient one precise portable integrity contract.
scope: Flat aliases and bounded real-file profile
acceptance: Top-level fields exactly format/version/algorithm/files; entries exactly name/size/sha256; reject unknown/duplicate keys and wrong types including bool integers.

Use 1–64 lowercase ASCII aliases matching [a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,63}, reject dot/dotdot, separators and trailing dot and reserved basenames con/prn/aux/nul/com1..9/lpt1..9 per docs/FIELDPACK.md; no implicit normalization.
Require sorted unique aliases, 1–32 entries, SHA-256 lowercase hex, 128MiB per file AND aggregate, 16KiB UTF-8 manifest, 64KiB chunks.
No URI/path/original filename/device identity/timestamp emitted; aliases literal, no percent decoding.

Freeze MATCH/MISSING/SIZE_MISMATCH/DIGEST_MISMATCH/UNREADABLE_OR_UNSUPPORTED; exit0 all match, exit1 any non-MATCH entry including unreadable, exit2 invalid manifest/root or operation-level error; interrupt130.
Reject malformed manifest before attachment opens; extra directory files ignored and explicitly stated.
Android profile accepts read-only regular seekable whole-file descriptors only; AOSP generated-only.
Mutation checks describe observed bytes, not immutable snapshot, authenticity or malware safety.

verification.procedure: Review frozen manifest/file specification and executable reference vectors. Native/JVM vector execution is downstream acceptance and does not block completion of the contract document.
verification.expected: All acceptance cases pass; retain actual counts, failures, environment and commit. No skipped native test counts as passing.

risks: Portable aliases intentionally restrict names; no broad Unicode/nested-path support.
Alias policy must align reference implementation before final acceptance.
Reference policy is frozen; native/JVM adoption must run the same versioned vectors.

Create publishes complete output outside input root with explicit no-overwrite behavior; failed creation leaves no success-shaped manifest; verifier never mutates inputs.

Test duplicate keys, bool sizes, limits, path escapes, injected read/mutation errors and interruption without claiming all mutation detection.
Root-relative safe opens and capability limitations documented; diagnostics expose aliases only.
Clean walkthrough creates/verifies project-owned note, CSV and PNG fixtures, then modifies/removes temporary copies; explicit Python-reference label, no Binder/Flutter/JVM completion.

tickets.title: Implement Android regular-file capability and descriptor ownership
tickets.value: Hash authorized real files across Binder without broad storage access.
acceptance: Broker receives actual cross-package descriptor; never reopens client URI/path; no file bytes in AIDL arrays.
Validate regular/seekable/read-only whole-file descriptor and known 0–128MiB length; reject pipe/socket/directory/closed/writable/subsection inputs without content probing.
Use positional reads from offset zero; client cursor changes do not alter digest.
Client closes local PFD after synchronous submit returns/errors; broker owns received PFD through rejection/duplicate/terminal/cleanup with exactly one close owner.
Same retained request metadata returns old job and closes incoming duplicate FD without reading; conflict closes FD.
Before/after same-FD metadata and exact byte count detect chosen changes; premature EOF/growth/read error cannot succeed.
One worker stays occupied until blocked read exits; no hard cancellation deadline, unsafe thread kill or replacement pool.
100-cycle rejection/acceptance tests show owned FD baseline recovery.
Reject st_nlink != 1 and explicitly unsupported source properties; absence of required validation cannot silently enable file capability.
